faqs.q: Sec. 30-64. - Certification and verification of recall petition.
faqs.a:
(a)
Upon the filing of signed petition, the city clerk shall have 20 days to review the
               petition and issue a certificate of sufficiency.
(b)
The provisions of
sections 30-35
(c) and (d) shall be followed in reviewing and certifying a recall petition, except
               that the signer must be a registered elector entitled to vote for the successor of
               the incumbent sought to be recalled.
(Code 1981, § 11-35; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
